findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "find_entry" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: open_sentence, get_quote · Private data: get_result · Public sink: open_sentence, get_quote, card_checkout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: open_sentence, get_quote · Private data: get_result · Public sink: open_sentence, get_quote, card_checkout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_quote" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
